name: KSR Register
query:
SELECT
    pi.department AS "Department",
    pi.date AS "Date",
    pi.patient AS "Patient ID",
    pi.patient_name AS "Patient Name",
    pi.mobile AS "Mobile",
    1 AS "Qty:Int:60"
FROM
    `tabQue` pi
    
WHERE
    pi.customer_group = 'KSR Campaign'
    AND pi.department IN ('ENT', 'Urology', 'General Surgery')
    AND pi.date BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s
ORDER BY
    pi.date ASC;
